analyst.summary: Trent's Q1 FY27 update (already out, 7-Jul-2026; full results due 6-Aug-2026) showed 19% revenue growth -- healthy in isolation, but below the Street's 22-23% expectation, and the stock fell over 12% on the day. Store additions remain strong (Zudio +28% YoY to 982 stores, Westside +21% YoY to 301), but per-store productivity is now declining, like-for-like sales growth has been muted since Q3 FY26, and the two adjacent bets -- Star Bazaar (grocery JV) and the Zara India JV -- both show revenue near-stalling with losses/profits moving the wrong way. The balance sheet remains excellent (26% ROE, low leverage), so this reads as a genuine quality business whose growth is normalizing from an earlier hyper-growth phase, not one that has broken -- but the rich earnings multiple still prices in more of that hyper-growth continuing than the current data supports. We rate it Hold: not a business to exit on fundamentals, but not one where the current price offers a margin of safety either.
